response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avgcnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avgcnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avgcnt
